calls.title: BestSeller & GrowthBook
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team prioritized accelerating experimentation for the Selected brand to tackle revenue challenges, especially in the men's segment impacted by previous platform changes. A proof of concept (POC) was proposed to integrate GrowthBook, Sanity, and Claude for user-friendly experimentation setups. Pricing negotiations included a tiered model offering discounts for a 10-brand rollout, with a POC budget of 45,000. Operational support was highlighted as crucial for less data-driven brand teams to adopt these tools effectively. A 30 to 45-day POC timeline was established to validate usability and integration before considering broader implementation.
calls.keywords: Experiments, Sanity integration, GrowthBook, Commercial model, POC, Brand tiering

calls.summary:
# BestSeller & GrowthBook
Date: 2026-08-25 | Duration: 31.770000457763672m

## Summary
The team discussed building a flexible experimentation framework that would support simple brand-level tests and complex cross-brand experiments. Kenneth Christiansen outlined a two-tier approach involving brand teams for simple A/B testing and the central Horizon team for broader platform tests. James Shannon confirmed the feasibility of running multi-brand experiments through GrowthBook, ensuring centralized analysis via Snowflake. The importance of automating experiment creation via an existing front-end tool, Insanity, was also emphasized, allowing non-technical users to generate experiments easily. Following up on technical validation and cost considerations, the team agreed on a phased approach to validate API-driven experiment creation and outlined next steps for planning a proof of concept.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Sanity CMS, experiment platform, A/B testing, API integration, proof of concept

## Action Items

**Kenneth Christiansen**
Review and test usage of GrowthBook API for experiment ID creation and management with internal developer Jonathan to assess viability before POC (28:38)
Prepare for follow-up meeting in approximately two weeks to update on progress and next steps (30:02)

**James Shannon**
Follow up by email with insights and support options regarding GrowthBook API use and best practices for experiment creation via Sanity integration (30:17)
Assist in scoping potential collaboration on API integration prior to full POC if required (27:50)
